scope: Exploratory synthesis on authenticated observed N; prior results already seen; not independent preregistration
unit: asset/class/ISIN; fixed 80 and 117, ten sectors, common 80 reused
primary_return: daily observed log wealth return, paired with B3 Ibovespa; no prices or expected returns as dependent variables
sector_statistics: median, IQR, median sector minus complement; eta squared of asset point estimates is descriptive only
sector_uncertainty: reuse Y shared-calendar moving-block draws, seeds [20261011,panel_offset,length], 999 replicates, lengths 5/10/20; length10 plotted primary; complete fixed-asset replicates required
sector_interpretation: marginal percentile intervals; approximate stationarity assumption; no new confirmatory rejection flags, no independent-asset or independent-year assumptions
risk: variance components with common n-1 denominator
historical simple-loss VaR95 inverse empirical CDF
historical simple-loss ES95 fractional upper-tail mass
risk_cases: five X cash variants on 277 full-period cases; N only on 1785 annual cases; common results reused
not_computed: Sharpe or Treynor without authenticated risk-free series
technical indicators or sequential covariance without feasibility study
figures: upside versus downside betas, all three panels
all-asset rolling delta maps with warm-up explicit
daily volatility and historical tail loss versus betas
annual daily volatility and market-model R2
